name: Nandin Dev Pack
description: Official agents from Nandin. My Work answers questions about your job from your own notes; PR Reviewer reviews pull requests against your rules; AWS Ops Analyst follows.

agents.name: My Work
agents.description: Answers questions about your role, what you own, who to ask and what's due, from your own notes and instructions, and says where every answer came from.

agents.name: PR Reviewer
agents.description: Reviews a GitHub pull request, private repositories included, against your own rules and the repo's guidelines, then posts the review on the PR once you approve the exact comments.
